message: `onIrq` is bound by `isr(irq)` and waits for an interrupt with IRQs masked: onIrq -> settle -> __arm_wfi
help: a handler bound to a vector runs while the code it interrupted is stopped - until it returns, for `isr(irq)`, and for good, for `isr(fault)` - so anything it waits for can't come. Every blocking library call ends in a system call, which baremetal-aarch64 answers with trap 74, and `__arm_wfi` in an IRQ handler sleeps with the interrupt that would wake it masked. Set a flag the main loop reads instead, and do the waiting there. A fault hook may halt in `wfi`: never returning is one of its answers

message: `onFault` is bound by `isr(fault)` and reaches a system call, where every blocking library call ends, and baremetal-aarch64 has no kernel to answer it: onFault -> note -> __syscall1
help: a handler bound to a vector runs while the code it interrupted is stopped - until it returns, for `isr(irq)`, and for good, for `isr(fault)` - so anything it waits for can't come.
